description: Development and application of high resolution SPEI drought dataset for Central Asia is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Karim Pyarali et al. Central Asia is a data scarce region, which makes it difficult to monitor and minimize the impacts of a drought. Coverage: continental; published in 2022. Formats: XML. The data are held in Oak Ridge National Laboratory and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Use of these data is covered by the following licence: http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/ . When using these data you must cite them correctly using the citation given on the CEDA Data Catalogue record., taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
